title: still present since round 4: vacancy/status mutations return Ok unconditionally — nonexistent ids report success
evidence: archive_vacancy: `let updated = list.map(store.vacancies, fn(v) { case v.vacancy.id == vacancy_id { False -> v True -> DemoVacancy(..v, archived_at: Some("2026-08-19T00:00:00Z")) } }) #(DemoStore(..store, vacancies: updated), Ok(vacancy_id))` — restore_vacancy and close_vacancy identical shape ending `Ok(vacancy_id)`; change_status ends `#(DemoStore(..store, vacancies: updated), Ok(slug))` — contrast update_vacancy/publish_vacancy which do `let next = DemoStore(..store, vacancies: updated) #(next, find_vacancy(next, vacancy_id) |> result.map(fn(v) { v.vacancy }))`; mark_notification_read likewise `#(DemoStore(..store, notifications: updated), Ok(notification_id))` with no match check.
detail: No find check on archive/restore/close/change_status/mark-read: any id (typed or stale) reports success; the error channel is dead where siblings use it.
recommended_fix: Mirror update_vacancy: find_vacancy/find the row first and return Error(Nil) when absent.

title: still present since round 4: mark_opened doc claims idempotent Submitted->UnderReview but applies to any status
evidence: doc: `/// POST /open - idempotently moves a Submitted application to UnderReview / /// and returns the post-transition status slug.` body: `change_status( store, vacancy_id, application_id, "under_review", "status_auto_changed", )` — change_status contains no current-status guard: `let target = status_from_slug(slug)` then unconditionally `DemoApplication(..app, application: Application(..app.application, status: target),`.
detail: A viewed/rejected/shortlisted demo application reverts to under_review on re-open; doc promises a Submitted-only idempotent transition.
recommended_fix: Guard change_status callers on current status == Submitted for mark_opened (no-op otherwise), or fix the doc.

title: still present since round 4: create_vacancy derives ids from an 8-char slug with no uniqueness check
evidence: create_vacancy: `let suffix = id_suffix(payload.property_name) let id = "v-demo-" <> suffix` ... `short_code: "RTDEMO" <> suffix` ... `vacancies: list.append(store.vacancies, [DemoVacancy(vacancy: vac, applications: [], archived_at: None)]),` — id_suffix comment: `/// Stable short id suffix from a property name (lowercase alphanumeric, / /// up to 8 chars) so re-created demo vacancies don't collide.` with `case string.length(cleaned) { n if n <= 8 -> cleaned n -> string.drop_end(cleaned, n - 8) }` — no check of the derived id against store.vacancies.
detail: Two demo creates with the same (or same-first-8-chars) name produce duplicate-id rows appended to the list; find_vacancy/for_edit/detail/leaderboard resolve to the first only.
recommended_fix: On collision, append a numeric suffix (scan store.vacancies for the derived id) before inserting.

title: still present since round 4: send_reminder / remind_applicant / send_bulk_invite mutate nothing and return canned counts
evidence: demo_store: `pub fn remind_applicant(store: DemoStore, _vacancy_id: String) -> #(DemoStore, #(Int, Int)) { #(store, #(1, 0)) }` / `pub fn send_reminder(store: DemoStore, _vacancy_id: String) -> #(DemoStore, #(Int, Int)) { #(store, #(2, 1)) }` / `pub fn send_bulk_invite(store: DemoStore, _vacancy_id: String) -> #(DemoStore, BulkInviteResult) { #( store, BulkInviteResult(sent: 2, invalid: 1,` — demo_api: `let #(next, result) = demo_store.send_reminder(store, vacancy_id) let _ = next deliver(on_response, result)` (x3) — awaiting ignores the store: `pub fn awaiting(_store: DemoStore, vacancy_id: String) -> List(AwaitingApplicant) { static_awaiting(vacancy_id) }` where v-maples Emma stays `reminded: False`.
detail: Reminder toasts report fixed counts regardless of the awaiting pool; reminded/followed_up flags never change, so remindable_count stays stale after reminding.
recommended_fix: Thread awaited-state through the store (mark reminded/followed_up) and derive the counts from it.

title: still present since round 4: demo dispatch arms remain unpinned — refcheck actions, single mark-read, report download, mark-opened threading, get_for_edit deep-link boot
evidence: demo_update arms with no dispatch-level pin: `UserClickedDownloadReport(id) ->` (:447), `UserChoseRefcheckAction(call_id, action) ->` (:481), `UserConfirmedRefcheckAction(call_id) ->` (:490), `UserSavedRefcheckEdit(call_id) ->` (:501), `UserClickedNotification(id, _entity_type, _entity_id) ->` (:551) — client_test.gleam:6392 builds every refcheck dispatch test on a NON-demo model: `let m = refcheck_detail_model([refcheck_call("rc-1", reference_call.Queued)])` (uses at 6402/6461/6477/6631/6685); demo coverage is store-level only (demo_flow_test.gleam:469 `pub fn demo_refcheck_actions_mutate_store_test()`); no test dispatches UserClickedNotification, UserClickedDownloadReport, or ApiReturnedApplicationOpened on a demo model, and the VacancyEdit get_for_edit boot is unpinned (only VacancyDetail is pinned).

title: demo UserClickedNotification drops the entity-navigation branch the real arm performs
evidence: demo arm: `UserClickedNotification(id, _entity_type, _entity_id) -> { let store = store_of(model) let #(next, eff) = demo_api.mark_notification_read(store, id, "", ApiReturnedMarkRead) // The real arm closes the dropdown after marking read — mirror it. #( Model(..model, demo_store: Some(next), show_notification_dropdown: False, ), eff, ) }` — real arm: `let navigate_eff = case entity_type, entity_id { Some("vacancy"), Some(vid) -> modem.push("/vacancies/" <> vid, None, None) _, _ -> effect.none() }` batched with mark_eff.
detail: The interception discards entity_type/entity_id: a vacancy-typed notification click never navigates in demo (shipped fixtures are all application-typed, so currently latent).
recommended_fix: Mirror the real navigate_eff branch in the demo arm before marking read.

title: still present since round 4: demo_not_in_demo_toast diverges from add_toast's id convention — ids can collide
evidence: demo_not_in_demo_toast: `let toast_id = model.next_toast_id + 1` ... `next_toast_id: toast_id,` — add_toast: `let id = model.next_toast_id` ... `#(Model(..model, toasts: capped_toasts, next_toast_id: id + 1), dismiss_eff)` — add_toast also caps (`let max_toasts = 5`), demo_not_in_demo_toast does not.
detail: After a demo chrome toast, the next fallback add_toast reuses next_toast_id — two live toasts share one id; AppDismissToast then dismisses both. No 5-toast cap either.
recommended_fix: Reuse add_toast (ToastInfo level) instead of the hand-rolled duplicate.

title: still present since round 4: store_of's None fallback re-seeds on every call without writing back to the model
evidence: `pub fn store_of(model: Model) -> DemoStore { case model.demo_store { Some(store) -> store None -> // Unreachable while demo_mode is True (entry/reset always seed first); // fall back to a fresh seed so the demo can never crash on a None. case demo_store.seed() { Ok(store) -> store Error(_) -> demo_store.empty_store() } } }` — read-only arms (e.g. AppRequestedDashboardData) never write demo_store back.
detail: With demo_store None, each store_of call seeds a fresh store; read-only arms leave it None so the seed repeats per request (deterministic, so latent).
recommended_fix: Have read-only arms write Some(store) back, or assert the invariant and drop the fallback.

title: still present since round 4: status_from_slug silently coerces unknown slugs to Submitted
evidence: `fn status_from_slug(slug: String) -> ApplicationStatus { case slug { "submitted" -> Submitted "under_review" -> UnderReview "shortlisted" -> Shortlisted "viewed" -> Viewed "approved" -> Approved "rejected" -> Rejected _ -> Submitted } }` — fed by change_status's unvalidated slug: `let target = status_from_slug(slug)`.
detail: An unrecognized status string (typo or new server slug) silently resets the demo application to Submitted instead of erroring.
recommended_fix: Return Result and propagate Error(Nil) for unknown slugs (feeds the dead error channel).

title: still present since round 4: fetch_leaderboard_page ignores its page parameter
evidence: `pub fn fetch_leaderboard_page( store: DemoStore, vacancy_id: String, _page: Int, on_response: fn(Result(LeaderboardResponse, ApiError)) -> msg, ) -> Effect(msg) { case demo_store.leaderboard(store, vacancy_id) { Ok(response) -> deliver(on_response, response) Error(_) -> deliver_err(on_response) } }` — store leaderboard returns the full entry list (`let entries = list.map(v.applications, leaderboard_entry)`), no windowing; caller passes `model.leaderboard_page + 1`.
detail: Demo load-more dispatches page+1 but always receives the identical full response — pagination semantics silently differ from the real api.
recommended_fix: Window the entries by page (matching the real page size) or document the single-page demo contract.

title: still present since round 4: zero-caller export shipped (demo_store.notifications)
evidence: `pub fn notifications(store: DemoStore) -> List(Notification) { store.notifications }` — grep of client/src and client/test for `demo_store.notifications(` (excluding notifications_unread) returns zero callers; demo_api.fetch_notifications uses `demo_store.notifications_unread(store)` instead.
detail: Unused pub export; the unread-carrying variant is the only consumer path.

title: still present since round 4: demo_update header claims the CI lint 'bans network imports from demo/' — the fetch ban exempts the whole demo_api.gleam file
evidence: demo_update header: `//// No network: every effect here comes from `demo/demo_api.gleam`, which / //// dispatches synchronously — the CI grep lint bans network imports from / //// `demo/`.` — test.yml: `FETCH_VIOLATIONS=$(grep -rln "gleam/fetch" client/src/demo/ --include="*.gleam" | grep -v "demo_api.gleam" || true)` (rsvp network verbs ARE banned everywhere: `RSVP_VERBS=$(grep -rnE "rsvp\.(send|get|post|put|patch|delete)" client/src/demo/ ...)`).
detail: The fetch exemption is file-wide, not function-scoped to download — any future gleam/fetch use anywhere in demo_api.gleam passes the CI lint.
recommended_fix: Scope the exemption (e.g. function-name guard) or soften the header claim.

title: still present since round 4: for_edit reports updated_at: vac.created_at and update_vacancy never bumps timestamps
evidence: for_edit: `status: vac.status, updated_at: vac.created_at,` — update_vacancy rebuilds the Vacancy field-by-field (property_name through status) with no updated_at/created_at change: `DemoVacancy(..v, vacancy: Vacancy(..old, property_name: payload.property_name, ... status: case payload.status { "active" -> Active "closed" -> Closed _ -> old.status }, ))`.
detail: The demo edit page always shows the original creation timestamp as 'updated'; edits never advance it.
recommended_fix: Bump a demo updated_at on update_vacancy (fixed ISO timestamp is fine) and report it in for_edit.
